prompts: Create one high-quality architectural concept presentation image, wide 3:2. Chinese game 黑洞空间站, title '01 / 世界总览 · 目标效果（非实机）'. Original clean advanced science-fiction inhabited station suspended ABOVE a gigantic nearby SILVER WHITE black hole. Its black event-horizon diameter is 4 times the whole station diameter; enormous white silver accretion/lensing arcs, absolutely no orange yellow purple plasma. Station whole circular plan diameter candidate 720m, central SQUARE 240m residential and arena core inside circle. The central arena is a small OPEN annular ring with hole through it, NOT solid disk. Four cross-axis bridges and continuous outer ring link exactly four quadrants. NORTH UP top right NE arrival port (01), top left NW science observatory (04), bottom right SE quiet cafe public life (02), bottom left SW garden conservatory (03), center residences+arena (05). Label quadrants minimally with number and Chinese name. Refined pearl-white curved panel shells, satin silver structural seams, charcoal recesses, glass observation galleries, concealed light, plants behind glass, no industrial clutter, no rust or grunge. Architecture is like a calm sophisticated research resort with believable modular joins and controlled density; not a spiky battleship, not a fantasy palace. 3/4 aerial view showing all quadrant topology and ring, small station in foreground with vastly larger silver black hole below and behind it. Tiny understated cool cyan details only, no neon outlines. Include small material swatches pearl white/satin silver/graphite/soft green, small human scale inset. The reference basis is actual Norm Architects Chancery House minimal stainless interior joint/light restraint, interpreted into original futuristic exterior, not copied. This is prospective art direction, not a real game screenshot. All text neat and sparse.

Create one exquisite 2x2 architectural game concept board, wide 3:2, title '02 / 四区空间 · 目标效果（非实机）'. FOUR equal panels of ONE consistent clean high-end advanced sci-fi station, quiet luxurious minimal architectural spaces, pearl-white smooth shell architecture, satin silver seams and edges, graphite floor inserts, concealed luminous ceilings, carefully arranged greenery. Real reference basis: Norm Architects Chancery House restrained satin stainless steel, gentle gradients of light, seamless geometric transitions and human-scale comfort, reinterpreted as original futuristic architecture. Upper-left '01 东北抵达港' tranquil tall arrival lounge with panoramic window, one elegant docked shuttle outside, directional portal. Upper-right '02 东南生活街' 3.8m-high intimate cafe with curved pearl-white ceiling, rounded service island, pale oak accents limited to furniture, taupe fabric seating grouped at tables, generous unobstructed walkway through framed doorway leading to glazed observing corridor. Bottom-left '03 西南生态园' luminous glazed conservatory with integrated white planters, diverse real-looking plants, gently branching paths and seating. Bottom-right '04 西北观测区' quiet silver-white science gallery and glass-fronted observation room, sculptural telescope instrument, understated console; beyond window an enormous nearby silver-white black hole with black center fills nearly entire view BELOW station level. Silver white accretion only absolutely no yellow/orange plasma. Interior warm-neutral light allowed but not amber cast. All panels eye-level believable first-person game target, no UI, no people required, not ruins, no exposed pipes, no industrial girders, no caution stripes, no hologram spam, no cyberpunk, no neon, no giant meaningless empty halls. Strong spatial composition and precise built-in furniture, sophisticated understated craft.
